{"subject":"Shipment-tracking at 2B events/day","body":"Hi Joris,

Lumen Logistics' shipment-tracking service writes 2B events/day to DataStax Enterprise 6.8, and your team is focused on modernising that cluster and reducing operational toil. With IBM's acquisition of DataStax complete, this may be a natural moment to review options.

ScyllaDB delivers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost for a write-heavy workload like this one.

Would a short comparison for a workload of that shape be useful?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s03"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_tco"],"context_fact_ids":["cf_ibm"]}
